title: Record QQ16 consumer accounting and the missing idle continuation
body:
## Summary

QQ16 local child counts and separate endpoint tariffs leave the displaced idle work unbound. This package matches the literal clean-J core to the selected profile, recounts the added local work, and makes that admission gap explicit.

```text
local producer + one decoder + separate consumer adapters
    -> global source/owner continuation and idle credit: unknown
    -> complete moment: unknown; no new kappa
```

The unchanged-idle common-FL screen has mass 66776 against parent mass 65408. It is conditional. The initial unconditional rejection was withdrawn before the scientific commit because new frame work might replace old remainders. The integer credit 1369 is only a strict zero-saving mass control, not a construction or kappa certificate.

Credit the retained QQ16/native lineage, [ywz65/PR2707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2707), [Arham Tahir/PR2681](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2681), [PR2678's separate-field tariff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2678), and the selected PR1094 compiler/geometry/owner lineage. Open next questions name the missing full replica continuation and coefficient maps.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Pinned local sources contain no complete QQ16 owner/frame continuation or displaced-idle receipt.
- **After:** Exact source-bound core/idle split, occurrence recount, conditional mass gates, typed corruption controls and a full obligation ledger. Actual idle credit and complete moment remain unknown.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and direct Python 3.12/3.14 checks pass. All registered script arguments and documented direct scripts pass in the committed regular-only, inode-disjoint, read-only Git-free export with TMPDIR unset. Exact commands, hashes, limitations and the designated internal peer receipt are retained in the package.
- No selected cold replay, full caller/native replay, physical implementation, new supplier or full theorem verification is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One isolated research package. Selected science and frozen predecessors are unchanged.
